sentences.l2: 很久以前，人们不知道怎么处理垃圾。
sentences.l1: A long time ago, people did not know how to deal with garbage.

sentences.l2: 后来，有人想了一个好办法。
sentences.l1: Later, someone thought of a good method.

sentences.l2: 他们在纸上画了三个箭头，组成一个三角形。
sentences.l1: They drew three arrows on paper, forming a triangle.

sentences.l2: 这个标志表示东西可以回收再用。
sentences.l1: This symbol means that things can be recycled and used again.

sentences.l2: 这个设计很简单，大家都看得懂。
sentences.l1: This design is very simple, and everyone can understand it.

sentences.l2: 三个箭头转圈跑，像在玩游戏。
sentences.l1: The three arrows run in a circle, as if playing a game.

sentences.l2: 它告诉我们：废纸、塑料瓶和易拉罐不是废物，可以变成新东西。
sentences.l1: It tells us: waste paper, plastic bottles and cans are not waste, and can become new things.

sentences.l2: 这个标志出现在杯子上、盒子上和街上。
sentences.l1: This symbol appears on cups, on boxes and on the street.

sentences.l2: 因为这个标志，越来越多的人开始分类垃圾。
sentences.l1: Because of this symbol, more and more people have started sorting garbage.

sentences.l2: 它有象征意义，代表环保主义。
sentences.l1: It has symbolic meaning and represents environmentalism.

sentences.l2: 好的废物管理能让城市更干净。
sentences.l1: Good waste management can make cities cleaner.

sentences.l2: 现在，全世界很多地方都能看到这个标志。
sentences.l1: Now, this symbol can be seen in many places all over the world.

sentences.l2: 人们一起努力，保护地球。
sentences.l1: People work hard together to protect the Earth.
The Earth is our common home.

sentences.l2: 看到这个标志，就把可回收的东西放在蓝颜色的垃圾桶里。
sentences.l1: When you see this symbol, put the recyclable things in the blue trash can.
Doing this is helping the environment.
